title: Start with recorded evidence
action: Open the Research lab and load the recorded research case. It needs no API or model download.
meaning: This is a real pinned Qwen copying diagnostic. You are replaying saved measurements, not running new inference.

title: Define the question
action: Open Case study. Read the blue-minus-red target, the donor and recipient contrast, and the prior hypothesis.
meaning: Check baseline task behavior before interpreting internals. This small exploratory example does not establish a general copying circuit.

title: Follow the computation graph
action: Return to Linked workspace. Select a component in the computation graph and inspect its block and site.
meaning: Structural edges describe the model architecture. An observed activation or a measured intervention is a different kind of evidence.

title: Inspect literal activations
action: Scroll to Activation microscope. Choose a token and a coordinate to inspect its signed floating-point value.
meaning: Check axes, normalization and saved-channel coverage. Omitted coordinates are unavailable, not zero; large values are not concept labels.

title: Read the output target
action: Inspect Target-output readout. Compare the target contrast across captured blocks and the available readout instruments.
meaning: A logit lens is an output projection, not a transcript of thoughts. The fitted lens uses a small separate development and held-out corpus.

title: Test effects and controls
action: Open Interventions. Compare raw signed changes with self, random, reverse and same-condition controls where recorded.
meaning: Gradient attribution is an estimate. Exact patches and receiver-path experiments are separate tests. Final full-residual replacement is a wiring control.

title: Keep features and error together
action: Open Features & circuits. Inspect reconstruction error and compare a feature attribution estimate with its exact measured edit.
meaning: The bundled identity dictionary is a nonlearned coordinate diagnostic. Reconstruction quality alone does not establish behavioral fidelity or a semantic feature.

title: Save an honest research record
action: Return to Case study. Review alternatives, unresolved interpretations and provenance, then use Case JSON to save the recorded evidence.
meaning: For new experiments, install the local runtime, validate a pinned model profile, freeze your study and record controls. Human scientific review remains necessary.
